notes.title: Abomination returns: A new era for PvP in The 4th Coming
notes.content:
Abomination Returns
We recognize the nostalgic significance of T4C and the long-awaited relaunch of the Abomination server is finally approching! After careful consideration, the development team has decided to retain the original server name, despite the community's suggestions, to honor its legacy.

No wipe is planned in the medium or long term, unless a significant issue affects the server or database (which is unlikely). This server launch is intended to be long-lasting.

The server will support multiple languages, including English, French, and German, to make it accessible to a broader community of players.

The current content is based on the latest version of Abomination from the Erodas period and will serve as the foundation for the server’s relaunch. 

Release Date
The official reopening of Abomination will take place this Friday, August 23, 2024 at 7:00 PM (Paris time) and 1:00 PM (Montreal/New York time), and will mark the beginning of a new era for the PvP scene of T4C.
 
Discord Server
Join T4C Discord
 
Server SettingsPlayers
 Starting stats: Classic (with dice rolls)

 XP coefficient: x1

 Maximum Level: 200

 Number of rebirths: 2

 Removable seraph wings: No

 Retroactive gain for HP and MP: Enabled (no need to raise a particular stat first)

 Personal and guild chest encumbrance: Limited to 5000 of encumbrance

Contents
 Number of characters per account: 5

 Character switching (via options): Disabled

 Day/Night cycle: Enabled

 Add-on v1.25 (The Crimsonscale Letter): Enabled (items will be balanced as needed)

 Planewalking (travel through portals): Enabled (reserved for seraph, the quest reset after a rebirth)

 Colliseum: Closed

 In-Game shop: No

Items
 Armlet of Flames: Damage & Frequency nerfed

 Bracer of the Immortals: Nerfed attribute bonuses

 Belt of Unstable Protection: Armor class nerfed

 Forest of No Return (FNR) items: Droppable (can be sold, lost or stolen)

 Ring of the Seraph: Non-droppable (reserved for good-aligned seraphs, removed upon rebirth)

PvP
 PvP starting level: 1

 PvP range: Unlimited (must be within 8 level for drops/losses)

 Safe zones: Temples + Inside building with doors (on all maps)

Death PenaltiesPlayer versus Player (PvP)
 Equipped items: 35%

 Inventory items: 45%

 Gold coins (dropped on the ground): 50%

 Experience: 5%

Player versus Environment (PvE)
 Equipped items: 5%

 Inventory items: 30%

 Gold coins (dropped on the ground): 35% 

 Experience: 5%

Enabled Systems
 Guilds

 Damage/Healing Display

 Professions

 Auction House

 Anti-Plug

 SpeedHack Protection

 XP Stats

 XP/Gold Scrolls

 Prison

Starting Items
 Cloth Pants

 Cloth Vest

 Rusty Dagger

 3 Torches

 100 to 150 Gold Pieces

New Features
We're excited to announce some of the new features that have recently been released.


 Support for 1680x1050 and 1920x1080 resolutions

 Smooth gameplay with 60 FPS support (16 and 32 FPS options available for modest systems)

 Real-time display of player attack range

 New option to show health and mana points above your character


For more informations and to consult the frequent changelogs, visit the T4C Development website. Keep an eye out for upcoming improvements and updates over the next few weeks and months. We're dedicated to enhancing your gaming experience!
 
Wiki
We are excited to announce the launch of the official Wiki dedicated to the Abomination server! This Wiki is an essential resource for all players, whether they are newcomers or veterans.

Access the Wiki 

How to contribute?
We need your help to build and refine this Wiki! If you have knowledge or experience to share, feel free to create an account to contribute to the content and help the community create the ultimate resource.

Greatness awaits !
Prepare yourself for the ultimate PvP experience as Abomination returns, bringing with it the intense, high-stakes gameplay that made it legendary. Are you ready to carve your name into the history of The 4th Coming once again?

Embrace your destiny, but remember, in this ruthless world, players make the rule, shaping the fate of the world through their actions and decisions.

notes.title: T4C Launcher - Your Gateway to Dialsoft and D4O AG servers
notes.content:
Overview
Introducing the T4C Launcher, a dedicated game launcher tailored for the MMORPG "The 4th Coming" (T4C). This versatile launcher facilitates seamless connections to both Dialsoft servers (international, available in English and French) and D4O AG servers (Europe, available in German).

Whether you're an adventurer exploring the diverse realms of Realmud, Neerya, Abomination, or 4th Saga on Dialsoft servers, or embarking on an epic journey on the official German server Schicksalswind presented by D4O AG, our launcher simplifies the game connection process for you.

Features

 Multi-Server Support: Switch effortlessly between Dialsoft and D4O AG servers to cater to your preferred gaming environment.
 Localized Content: Information is presented in both English and German, catering to a diverse player base.
 Engaging UI: Enjoy a visually appealing and informative design to enhance your overall user experience.
 Convenient Account Creation: Hyperlinks within the launcher simplify the account creation process on your chosen servers, streamlining onboarding.
 Default Server Options: Set default servers for quick access to your preferred gaming environment.
 System Tray Minimization: Minimize the launcher to the system tray for a clutter-free desktop. Access it conveniently with a simple click on the tray icon.
 Show/Exit Options: Easily bring the launcher back to the forefront or exit it gracefully from the system tray. Control your launcher's visibility effortlessly.
 Settings Menu: Access in-game settings (T4C Config) conveniently from the launcher, allowing personalized gaming experiences without navigating through multiple folders.


How to Use
[olist]
 Select Server: Choose between Dialsoft (International) and D4O AG (German) tabs.
 Explore Information: Read about each server, its unique features, and the game version.
 Create Account: Utilize provided hyperlinks to create accounts on respective servers.
 Play: Hit the "PLAY" or "SPIELEN" button to start the game with your chosen server.
 Default Server: Optionally, set a default server for quicker access in future launches.
[/olist]

The T4C community for their continued support and enthusiasm.

The Steam integration is now better than ever. We're always working on adding new features – got any ideas or requests? Let us know!

Enjoy your adventures in The 4th Coming—your gateway to immersive gameplay awaits!
